verdict.rationale: Nix offers isolated, reproducible environments: `nix-shell` and `nix develop` dev shells, VM-based integration testing, and atomic installs with rollback. A community user praises temporary installs for trying software without lasting effects. These let a user test changes in a throwaway environment instead of on a live system, but nothing explicitly addresses separating test runs from production data or offering an agent-oriented sandbox mode. Missing for 10: explicit isolation from production data or services, documentation of a sandboxed test workflow for AI agents, and independent hands-on corroboration of VM-based test isolation.
